reason: A is the better proposal because a refractory metallic interlayer is more plausible and directly testable as a Cr–Zr transport barrier, whereas B’s 10–20 nm nanocrystalline diamond layer is unlikely to remain continuous and chemically inert at 1100 °C, and its cited evidence does not support the claimed buried-barrier mechanism or ≥50% reduction. A still requires correction of the claim that Nb has low solubility with Zr and tighter exposure-time and falsification criteria.
